crew.overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
crew.title: Avengers: Endgame

crew.overview: A listless Wade Wilson toils away in civilian life with his days as the morally flexible mercenary, Deadpool, behind him. But when his homeworld faces an existential threat, Wade must reluctantly suit-up again with an even more reluctant Wolverine.
crew.title: Deadpool & Wolverine

crew.overview: Against the vibrant backdrop of a 1960s-inspired, retro-futuristic world, Marvel's First Family is forced to balance their roles as heroes with the strength of their family bond, while defending Earth from a ravenous space god called Galactus and his enigmatic Herald, Silver Surfer.
crew.title: The Fantastic 4: First Steps

crew.overview: Willy Wonka – chock-full of ideas and determined to change the world one delectable bite at a time – is proof that the best things in life begin with a dream, and if you’re lucky enough to meet Willy Wonka, anything is possible.
crew.title: Wonka

crew.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
crew.title: Avengers: Infinity War

crew.overview: The Guardians must fight to keep their newfound family together as they unravel the mysteries of Peter Quill's true parentage.
crew.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2

crew.overview: After the death of Emperor Marcus Aurelius, his devious son takes power and demotes Maximus, one of Rome's most capable generals who Marcus preferred. Eventually, Maximus is forced to become a gladiator and battle to the death against other men for the amusement of paying audiences.
crew.title: Gladiator

details.biography:
Robert Allman is a visual effects supervisor at Framestore, based in London. He earned an MA in Computer Animation from London Guildhall in 1997. He began his career immediately afterwards by joining Mill Film. In those early years, he contributed to blockbuster films such as Gladiator (2000), Lara Croft: Tomb Raider (2001) and the early entries in the Harry Potter franchise.

After gaining experience in technical and CG roles, he joined Framestore as a Technical Director. There, he re-entered the Harry Potter world, working on Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004) and leading CG sequences on Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005). He later moved to Prime Focus, where he became CG Supervisor on films such as Mirror Mirror (2012) and Poltergeist (2015), before returning to Framestore.

At Framestore, he played a key role in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, working as CG Supervisor on Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2 (2017), Avengers: Infinity War (2018) and Avengers: Endgame (2019). His early pre-production work on Avengers: Endgame was especially notable for helping to develop the machine-learning system used to bring the “Smart Hulk” character to life. He was promoted to VFX Supervisor at Framestore for Doctor Dolittle (2020), The Little Mermaid (2023), Wonka (2023), Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), and The Fantastic Four: First Steps (2025).

For Avengers: Endgame (2019), he was nominated for a Visual Effects Society Award for Outstanding Animated Character in a Photoreal Feature for “Smart Hulk”, and for Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire (2005), he was nominated for Outstanding Created Environment in a Live Action Motion Picture for the Black Lake environment.
details.name: Robert Allman
